game.title: Shelf Sort
game.tagline: Fill every shelf with three matching goods

a11y.help: Tap a goods item to lift it, then tap an empty slot to place it; tap the lifted item again to put it down. Arrow keys move between slots, Enter or Space lifts and places, Z undoes a move, R restarts the level.
a11y.won: Level complete in {moves} moves, {stars} of 3 stars.
a11y.titleDemo: Title screen: the game is sorting itself.
a11y.occupied: That slot is occupied. Choose an empty slot.

coach.step1: Tap an item to lift it.
coach.step2: Tap an empty slot to place it.
coach.step3: Match three on a shelf to clear it.
coach.keys: Keys: arrows · Enter/Space · Z undo · R restart
